title: C: Palindrome Checker
description: Check if a given string is a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backwards) and print the result.

steps.title: Check Palindrome
steps.description: Declare `char str[] = "racecar"`. Write a loop that compares characters from both ends to check if it's a palindrome. Print 'Palindrome' or 'Not a palindrome'.
hints: If any pair doesn't match, it's not a palindrome.

verification.failureMessage: Check if 'racecar' is a palindrome and print the result
